params.name: searchText
params.description: The input to be searched.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude of the location. We need to make sure that either Lat/Lng or Country is provided to API

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of the location. We need to make sure that either Lat/Lng or Country is provided to API

params.name: searchRadius
params.description: Radius range within which search is performed.

params.name: searchRadiusUnit
params.description: Radius unit such as Feet, Kilometers, Miles or Meters.

params.name: maxCandidates
params.description: Maximum number of POIs that can be retrieved.

params.name: country
params.description: Country ISO code. We need to make sure that either Lat/Lng or Country is provided to API

params.name: matchOnAddressNumber
params.description: Option so that we force api to match on address number

params.name: autoDetectLocation
params.description: Option to allow API to detect origin of API request automatically

params.name: areaName1
params.description: State province of the input to be searched

params.name: areaName3
params.description: City of the input to be searched

params.name: postCode
params.description: Postal Code of the input to be searched

params.name: returnAdminAreasOnly
params.description: if value set 'Y' then it will only do a matching on postcode or areaName1, areaName2, areaName3 and areaName4 fields in the data

params.name: includeRangesDetails
params.description: if value set 'Y' then display all unit info of ranges, if value set 'N' then don't show ranges

params.name: searchType
params.description: Preference to control search type of interactive requests.

params.name: searchOnAddressNumber
params.description: Preference to search on address number.

params.name: searchOnUnitInfo
params.description: Preference to search on unit info.

params.name: searchOnPOBox
params.description: Specifies whether to enable search for matching on PO Box.
